key_provisions_or_claims: Russian criminal law has no AI-specific offences, but existing norms can be applied to traditional subjects who use AI.
Recommends strengthening liability under the current Criminal Code by introducing a qualifying aggravating feature for AI use.
If AI or robots were recognised as legal subjects, the subjective element (mens rea) would be the key problem.
Without strong AI, AI use can be treated as part of the objective side of the offence.
annotation.summary_en: Russian journal article on criminal-law responsibility for AI and robotics. It argues that existing Criminal Code offences can apply to human actors using AI, proposes an aggravating qualifying feature for AI-enabled crimes, and notes that mens rea would be the central issue if AI gained legal personality.
